name: southbrook-kitchen-3d-configurator-node-tests
description: PR3a — Node-native regression harness for southbrook_kitchen_3d_configurator. NOT Hoot: this environment has no headless-Chromium binary (Ubuntu 24.04 ships chromium as a snap-only transitional package; no snapd). Mounts the REAL kitchen_configurator.js OWL component under jsdom + the real @odoo/owl package (pinned to the vendored 2.8.2), and exercises the real coordinate-math builders + KitchenCanvas._placeCabinetGroup with the real vendored r160 Three.js — no WebGL context needed for pure matrix math. See README.md.
